scheme_name: Cultural Function And Production Grant Scheme
other_conditions: The applicant must be a voluntary organization or NGO.
The organization must have a properly constituted managing body with powers, duties and responsibilities defined in a written constitution.
The organization must be registered under the Societies Registration Act (XXI of 1860), Trusts Act, Companies Act, or any Central or State Act for at least three years.
The organization must register on the NGO Darpan Portal of NITI Aayog and obtain a Unique ID.
The Unique ID and the PAN Number of the organization must be provided while applying.
The organization must have matching resources amounting to at least 25 % of the project cost.
The organization should have facilities, resources, personnel, and experience to undertake the proposed event/project.
Past experience of organizing similar functions is given preference.
Foreign delegations may not be invited without prior permission from the Ministry of External Affairs routed through the Ministry of Culture.
benefits_summary: Provides a grant covering up to 75 % of project expenditure, capped at ₹5 lakh per project, with possible increase up to ₹20 lakh for projects of outstanding merit.
documents_required: Recommendation letter from a National Academy or other culture‑related organization
